lore: {name}: A table where the stars hold still while you choose.
use: Pick your enchantments yourself: three random ones that fit the item, each with a slider from 0 to its maximum, paid from a level budget that the bookshelves around it and the obsidian floor below set (up to 50).
secret: Hold eight Netherite Nuggets in your off hand and strike an Enchanting Table with a Netherite Sledgehammer: it becomes this. Break it and table and nuggets return.

lore: {name}: The Dark Enchanter after it has seen the End; the stars swirl in its cloth.
use: Like the Dark Enchanter, but strength 60 on a whole Nihil Obsidian floor, where Protection and Feather Falling reach V. Blazing Obsidian works only half here.
secret: Eight Enderite Nuggets and an Enderite Sledgehammer turn a Dark Enchanter into it. The anvil still cannot make Protection V; only this table can.

lore: A book bound with blaze powder instead of leather. It never quite cools down.
use: Three of them go into a blazewood bookshelf.
secret: Blazewood shelves reward the {item:simpleenchanting:dark_enchanter}: each counts for two ordinary shelves there.

lore: Crying obsidian's glowing sibling: where the other weeps, this one burns.
use: A decorative block that gives light. Its job is at the Dark Enchanter: a 5 x 5 floor of it right under the table adds 10 strength once the shelves give 30. Under the Astral Enchanter it works only half.
secret: The floor only counts under the enchanters, not the vanilla table, so build it once the shelves are complete.

lore: Blazing Obsidian that met the void: the embers went out and navy light stayed.
use: Eight Nihilith Shards around crying obsidian make it. A 5 x 5 floor of it under the Astral Enchanter adds 20 strength once the shelves give 30, enough for 60; under the Dark Enchanter it counts like Blazing Obsidian.
secret: Mixing both obsidians still makes a floor, but the Astral Enchanter then counts it only half.

lore: {name}: wood that has been given fire to keep, and keeps it quietly.
use: Eight blaze powder around one crimson or warped plank give one blazewood plank. It is the material for blazewood bookshelves.
secret: Only crimson and warped planks take the blaze powder, since only nether wood is at home in the heat.

lore: {name} holds books that are bound with fire, and their pages are warm to the touch.
use: A bookshelf of blazewood: it counts as two bookshelves at the Enchanter and as one at the vanilla enchanting table. Three {item:simpleenchanting:blaze_book} go into it.
secret: Around the Enchanter, a 5 x 5 floor of {item:simpleenchanting:blazing_obsidian} adds strength on top of the shelves, once they give 30.
